meta.title: EvoAgent exploration lab
meta.description: Host tools only, no panel. Periodic GitHub checks; exact-version approval required to install. Use evoagent_update for status. evoagent_plan → review requests → evoagent_explore → evoagent_records. Sends task prompt and strategies to your configured provider/model; charges may apply. Disable/restart discards volatile caches. No autonomous training or activation; sample passes are not proofs.
